data.text:
When we joined Ronin, we were met with intense and at times malicious treatment from the kttyworld community. It reached a point where our team chose to return a 20K grant because we believe in what we are building and wanted to stand on our own conviction.

Since then, kttyworld has gone on to raise thousands through multiple mints, a token launch, and grants, yet has not delivered and is now shutting down.

First of all, I forgive everyone who got carried away with malicious comments. I do not believe my team at @sillykittiesco deserved that kind of treatment. We are genuinely here to uplift the community and deliver something never seen before.

I have given a lot to the Ronin community for six years now, and this was my first time launching a project, so seeing that behavior was honestly surprising and disappointing.

I welcome everyone who loves Kitties to join us. We are building a global brand.

@kitteygg is my cofounder, a highly competent developer with more than 10 years of experience in mobile games and business apps. She has delivered games with over 10 million downloads and understands how difficult it is to build and ship at scale. That is one of the main reasons I chose to join her vision after meeting her at YGG Summit 2024.

Also, she has three cats, so that makes her even more qualified.

Currently, we have 

- partnerships with multiple establishments in the Philippines.

- our flagship mobile game in production.

- Season 1 of our animation in production. 

- plushies in production, soon for sale!

- GIFs that have surpassed 300 million views in just three months.

All the wheels are in motion. When we launch our PFP and token, the community will be walking into an already growing brand, and web3 asset holders will benefit from everything we are building, the way it is meant to be done.

I am not asking for money right now. All I need is your support through a like, comment, or share.

Cats have one of the highest content traffic in all of the internet. Hello Kitty has a lifetime revenue of 800 BILLION dollars, we just want 1% of their market share and flow it back to our web3 community.

Join us at https://t.co/R369SDizhh

Follow us @sillykittiesco 

Lets build together. Stay Silly. I love you all!
